card.name: The word even as an intensifier
card.fires_on: The word "even" used to stress a surprising extreme, often after "and" or a comma. Also fires on nearby words where "even" is expected next, such as "could" or "more".

modes.label: Even as intensifier
modes.description: The word "even" itself, adding a surprising extreme to a list or claim.
modes.example: With restaurants, bars, post office, and<< even>> a supermarket, China's first aircraft carrier

modes.label: Even after a comma or "between"
modes.description: "even" introducing a narrower case or a low-dose condition.
modes.example: The syndrome can develop after relatively brief treatment periods,<< even>> at low doses.

modes.label: Words setting up an "even" or similar emphasis
modes.description: A word just before a stressed or surprising continuation, where emphasis is likely.
modes.example: Believe it or not, you<< could>> make your own money!

card.writes: It lowers the chance of repeating "even" or its equivalents ("甚至", "sogar") right after, since the emphasis is already placed.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text says "even" to stress a surprising extreme.
